findings.finding: The entrypoint computes ResNet-50 features before checking for cifar10_resnet50_features.pth, but never saves the computed features and declines training when that untracked file is absent.
The pretrained ResNet-50 classifier head is replaced by a newly initialized Linear(2048,512)+ReLU layer, so the 512-dimensional projection itself is not a published pretrained checkpoint.
N_REPEATS is 1, so the plotted standard-deviation ribbon is identically zero and supplies no sampling uncertainty.
WFR/WGF inner iteration counts vary by epoch and reach 200, whereas the Figure 6 caption states 100 inner loops.
WRM invokes optimizer_theta.step() twice per batch.

effect_on_falsification: None of these code limitations is used as a counterexample. The falsification uses the authors' own committed full Figure 6 vector curves.
